data.exact_reserve_text:
The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a release of GBP 0.2m (2016: GBP 0.4m).
In 2017, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.2m (2016: GBP 0.7m) due primarily to a reduction in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2017 year of account.
The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2017 year of account.
The syndicate has no material exposure to Hurricane Maria at all.
Significant tornado activity in Texas alongside losses from Hurricane Matthew has elevated the incurred loss ratio somewhat.
Following the Californian wildfires in October the year is likely to generate a loss but not a severe one.
There was also continued tornado-hail activity in the early part of the year, particularly in Texas and the Mid-West.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year claims reserves show a very small adverse re-estimation (gross strengthening of approximately GBP 0.01m on 2015 and earlier years per the gross claims development table). However the syndicate reports an overall net surplus (net release) of around GBP 0.2m driven by favourable claims development as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwound. The business is a US property catastrophe book, and the reserve movements reflect refinement of catastrophe estimates rather than material new large loss emergence.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross strengthening of GBP 0.01m for 2015+). The report also explicitly states a net release of GBP 0.2m in the net provisions for claims; net and gross figures diverge due to reinsurance and rounding. Triangle and movement sentences are small amounts and subject to rounding. RITC and commutations are present in notes and may distort movements; amounts in the report are presented in GBP '000 (triangle) and have been converted to millions where required.
